# ePlus OnAir

> ePlus OnAir is an internet radio directory for discovering and listening to live radio stations from countries around the world.

## Canonical site

- https://radio.eplus.dev/

## Discovery

- Sitemap: https://radio.eplus.dev/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://radio.eplus.dev/robots.txt
- Agent guide: https://radio.eplus.dev/agents.md

## Site structure

- /`area` — browse countries in a region
- /`area`/`country` — browse radio stations in a country
- /`area`/`country`/`station` — listen to a specific station
- /about — project purpose and architecture overview
- /statistics — build-time catalog coverage totals
- /contact — bug, station-update, and rights-request guidance
- /privacy-policy — privacy and third-party service policy
- /terms-of-use — site and third-party stream terms

## Public catalog data

- World/country metadata: https://radio.eplus.dev/radio/world.json
- Country station catalog: https://radio.eplus.dev/radio/{area}/{country}.json

The JSON catalogs are read-only discovery data. Stream URLs and realtime schedule/current-song/lyric data can change independently of the static catalog.

Station pages may include live program, track, schedule, and lyric data when available.
